lines.zh: 顺着树冠的缝隙往上飘。
lines.en: I drift upward through a gap in the canopy.

lines.zh: 触须拖在身后，像小灯穗。
lines.en: My tentacles trail behind like lamp tassels.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就歪着过去了。
lines.en: One gust and I lean off that way.

lines.zh: 离地三尺，正好避开蕨叶。
lines.en: Three feet up, just clearing the ferns.
I drift slowly, yet never lose my way.

lines.zh: 黑森林的树干，我一棵棵数。
lines.en: In the dark forest I count the trunks one by one.
My light travels with me, and so does my shadow.
A little higher; the dew is too heavy.
Around the cobwebs; do not snag my tendrils.

lines.zh: 我飘过的地方，叶子亮了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the leaves brighten.

lines.zh: 夜里赶路，全靠自己发光。
lines.en: Traveling at night, I light my own way.

lines.zh: 贴着溪面飞，能看清石头。
lines.en: Skimming the stream, I can see every stone.
A slow turn spreads my glow around.

lines.zh: 树冠太密，我侧着身子挤。
lines.en: The canopy is thick; I slip through sideways.

lines.zh: 我把光收小一点，好穿过去
lines.en: I dim my light a little to slip through.

lines.zh: 露水打湿触须，我甩了甩
lines.en: Dew wets my tentacles; I shake them.
My glow swells and fades, as if breathing.
Hanging from a branch, posing as a lamp.
A bug bumps into me; it tickles.

lines.zh: 白天我几乎看不见自己。
lines.en: By day I can barely see myself.
The little flame under my bell must not go out.

lines.zh: 树叶滴水，砸在我的伞上。
lines.en: A leaf drips onto my bell.
I am waiting for the mist to thin.

lines.zh: 光太亮会招来不该来的。
lines.en: Too bright a glow draws things I would rather avoid.
I dim myself down and fold into the night.

lines.zh: 林子深处有谁在叫我吗？
lines.en: Is someone calling from deeper in the woods?

lines.zh: 触须一圈圈收起来，暖些。
lines.en: I coil my tendrils in, a little warmer.
My light looks best over this patch of moss.
Hovering in place counts as rest.

lines.zh: 天亮之前，我得找地方沉下去。
lines.en: Before dawn I must find somewhere to sink.
Your torch is far dimmer than I am.
Are you looking at me, or making a wish?
Do not reach out; my light can burn.

lines.zh: 你能看见我，说明夜够深。
lines.en: You can see me, so the night is deep enough.

lines.zh: 你袖口有松脂味，像火把。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of resin, like a torch.
Look up; I am right above your head.
Some take me for a star.

lines.zh: 你一动，我照的光就跟着晃。
lines.en: Move, and the light I cast sways with you.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但记得你的脸。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I will remember your face.
Standing so far off, afraid I will go out?
My glow flickers twice; I am hurt.
Keep cold iron away from my bell.

lines.zh: 触须断了一根，疼得发麻。
lines.en: One tendril is severed, and it throbs.

lines.zh: 我暗了下去，又强撑亮起。
lines.en: I dim, then force myself bright again.
One hit and my bell is dented.
My light scattered; I must gather it again.
I sink half a foot before steadying.
Who strikes at a lamp?
I want to hide behind the leaves.
Stop chasing; I cannot fly fast.

lines.zh: 你手里那点萤石粉，给我。
lines.en: That glowstone dust in your hand: give it here.

lines.zh: 再亮一点，我就能看清你。
lines.en: A bit brighter and I could see you clearly.

lines.zh: 有光的地方，我就想靠过去。
lines.en: Wherever there is light, I want to lean in.
The flame in that lamp is lovely.

lines.zh: 别把萤火虫放走，我要看。
lines.en: Do not free those fireflies; I want to watch.
The closer I get, the brighter I burn.

lines.zh: 给我一点火，我回你一片光。
lines.en: Give me a spark and I will return a patch of light.

lines.zh: 那团发光的菌，是我的亲戚吗？
lines.en: Is that glowing fungus a relative of mine?
Raise the lamp; let me hover close a while.

lines.zh: 我跟着光走，从不问去处。
lines.en: I follow light and never ask where it leads.

lines.zh: 撞到我，像撞进一团温水。
lines.en: Bumping me feels like touching warm water.

lines.zh: 光晃了一下，别再来一次。
lines.en: My light flickered; do not do that again.
You knocked my tendrils apart.

lines.zh: 我软，可也不是给你推的。
lines.en: I am soft, but not here to be shoved.
My bell tilts; I settle it back.
I drift aside to let the path clear.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，你会被照花眼。
lines.en: This close, my glow will dazzle you.
On impact I pulled my glow in tight.
Keep your blade off me; cold iron stings.
Half a step back and we both see better.
Two lanterns side by side, pulsing in time.
Its glow leans green, mine leans white.
We circle each other, drawing closer.

lines.zh: 触须轻轻碰一下，就够了。
lines.en: One light brush of tendrils is enough.
It brightens; I brighten, like answering.

lines.zh: 树梢上那一点光，是我的伴。
lines.en: That speck on the treetop is my companion.

lines.zh: 两盏灯垂着，谁也不先动。
lines.en: Two lamps hang still, neither moving first.

lines.zh: 雾里两团光，慢慢走成一处。
lines.en: Two glows in the mist slowly merge into one.

lines.zh: 它比我小一圈，光却更暖。
lines.en: It is smaller than me but warmer.
Following it, the road is never quite dark.

lines.zh: 挑一粒露珠，托在触须上。
lines.en: I lift a dewdrop on one tendril.
This fallen leaf will hold me a moment.
I gather a small piece of glowing moss.

lines.zh: 把它含在伞盖里，慢慢化。
lines.en: Held inside my bell, it slowly melts.
Fallen motes of light, I keep them.
One soft scoop, without troubling the water.
Will this seed glow, I wonder?

lines.zh: 带走一点，留一点在原处。
lines.en: Take a little, leave a little behind.
I pick things up with tendrils only.
Tucked away before the wind takes it.
That thing is moving; it is no branch.
It carries a net; does it mean to catch me?

lines.zh: 我调暗了光，它还在看这边。
lines.en: I dimmed my glow; it still looks this way.
Up two blocks first, to see clearly.
The smell of iron is coming closer.
I must not let it stand directly below.

lines.zh: 它举手的动作，我记住了。
lines.en: I noted the way it raised its hand.
Higher; the canopy may block its view.
This thing is chasing my light.
I draw my tendrils in, ready to hide.
It takes a step; I give an inch.
I drop to dim light, keeping only a spark.
Around the trunk, matching its turn.

lines.zh: 手一抬，我立刻升高半尺。
lines.en: A hand lifts; I rise half a foot at once.
Tendrils down, I test the wind.

lines.zh: 盯着它的眼睛，别盯着手。
lines.en: Watch its eyes, not its hands.

lines.zh: 我在数它还有几步能到。
lines.en: I count how many steps it needs to reach me.

lines.zh: 它不动，我的光也压到最低。
lines.en: It freezes, so I press my glow down low.
A tree behind me; my retreat is open.
The steadier my glow, the less it can guess.
My tendrils sweep across with a faint burn.
Do not grab me; my light stings the eyes.

lines.zh: 贴上它的手背，轻轻一烫。
lines.en: I brush its hand and leave a small burn.
A sudden flare to blind it for a moment.
I lunge like a puff of warm mist.
Tendrils wrap its cuff, then let go.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖边缘，比看上去硬。
lines.en: My bell's rim is harder than it looks.
I gather my light to a point and thrust.

lines.zh: 它缩手了，我就再亮一次。
lines.en: It pulls back; I flare once more.
My blows are light but they burn.
The first point of light rises in the mist.
I lift off a heap of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 黑森林的夜，正好接住我。
lines.en: The dark forest night catches me as I form.
My bell forms first; the tendrils follow.
Trees on every side; no sky in sight.
Dew clings to my bell, cold and bright.

lines.zh: 有蛙叫，有虫鸣，我听见了。
lines.en: Frogs and insects call; I hear them all.
This lamp begins shining tonight.

lines.zh: 树冠层很高，够我飘很久。
lines.en: The canopy is high enough to drift a long while.

lines.zh: 先亮着，看看有没有同伴。
lines.en: I will glow first and see if anyone answers.
A flame nearby scrambles my glow.

lines.zh: 一直下坠，光拖成一条线。
lines.en: Dropping and dropping, my light trails a line.
Soaked through, my glow goes dim at once.

lines.zh: 响声震散了雾，也震散了我。
lines.en: The blast scatters the mist, and me with it.
An arrow pierces my bell; light leaks out.

lines.zh: 有个咒语想拴住我的光。
lines.en: Some spell is trying to leash my light.

lines.zh: 光越来越弱，我该去吃东西了。
lines.en: My glow weakens; I should go and feed.
The lightning outshines me, and I resent it.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，光也照不到。
lines.en: No bottom below, and no light reaches it.
